content: HIBERIX® is specifically indicated for use as a booster dose to provide active immunization against invasive diseases caused by Haemophilus influenzae type b. It is approved for administration in children aged 15 months to 4 years, up until the day before their fifth birthday. This vaccine is intended to be used as a booster dose in children who have already completed a primary vaccination series with a Haemophilus b Conjugate Vaccine that has been licensed for primary immunization. HIBERIX® is not approved for use as a primary immunization vaccine. The effectiveness of HIBERIX® as a booster dose has been evaluated based on the immune responses it elicits in children, using serological markers that are predictive of protection against invasive diseases caused by Haemophilus influenzae type b. However, these protective antibody levels have not been directly assessed in clinical trials that compare a booster dose of HIBERIX® to a booster dose of another Haemophilus b Conjugate Vaccine licensed in the United States, in children who have previously received a primary series with a US-licensed Haemophilus b Conjugate Vaccine.
